main.summary: Resolves security identities from an identity directory.

method.name: ResolveIdentityObjectId
method.summary: Resolve an identity by object identifier.
method.param: Cancellation token for the resolve operation.
method.returns: The resolved identity, or null when no identity matches the object identifier.

method.name: ResolveIdentityThumbprint
method.summary: Resolve an identity by certificate thumbprint.
method.param: Cancellation token for the resolve operation.
method.returns: The resolved identity, or null when no identity matches the thumbprint.
